pieces.title: C Major — Contrary Motion
pieces.description: Two-hand contrary motion scale. Best opening exercise — the hands diverge, then mirror back. Phase-lock here before moving on.

pieces.title: Two-Part Invention in C (excerpt)
pieces.description: Four measures: RH states the subject, LH answers an octave down, both hands converge in scalar counter-motion. Classic two-voice independence study.

pieces.title: Prelude in A — Mazurka Study
pieces.description: Eight bars in 3/4. RH carries a dotted-rhythm melody; LH walks the mazurka's bass–chord–chord pulse. Phase-lock here means your left hand's three-pulse holds steady under the right's dotted syncopation — the thread the Norns are listening for.
